title: Jaane sakina
body:
baba kujaai baba kujaai
kahan ho baba
<<DIVIDER>>
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mai qaid may hoo aap kahan ho baba
laadli beti ko ek baar pukaro baba
paas aao ya mujhe paas bulalo baba
apne daaman may sakina ko chupalo baba
mere baba mujhe do aa ke sahara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
haye sehti hai sitam aap ki beti baba
khoon behta hai mere kaan hai zakhmi baba
cheen kar le gaye kyun baaliyan meri baba
maangte aa ke jo mujhse to mai deti baba
kitna mushkil hai sakina ka guzara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
baba kal khwaab may tum paas mere aaye thay
godh may asghar e masoom ko bhi laaye thay
bhai akbar chacha abbas yahin baithe thay
baari baari galay lipta ke mujhe rote thay
jaane kab dekhungi kunba mai dobara
ay jaan e sakina kahan ho kahan ho
charagh e zindan...
ai baba ye khubam...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba tum paas nahi chacha abbas nahi
baba tum paas nahi koi bhi aas nahi aas nahi
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
ai baba ye khubam kujaai kujaai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din baba ka sar bali sakina ko mila
ashk baar aankhon se baba ne sakina se kaha
haye kis haal may tum hum se mili ho beta
ab wo seena hi nahi jis pe sulaaye baba
apna sar rakh de mere sar pe sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
charagh e zindan khamoshe em shab
author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & M. Abdollahi
